checks.dump_check: the B=65536, one-round walk dumps are byte-identical between base and new builds

environment: curvesma-reference-count (gcc Debian 14.2.0-19, valgrind 3.24.0, linux/arm64); -O3 -fno-tree-vectorize -mgeneral-regs-only -static; fixed-seed uniform field inputs shared by both builds.

files.generator: not shipped, as the base omits gen10..gen55

scope: Finite organizer-image instruction counts, not a production execution or a proof of collision probabilities. Schedule pairs differ only in the dispatch and the skipped anchor load/compare; unroll16 pairs only in the copy count, every body, tail, slow block and rare path being byte-identical.
units: Ir between two CALLGRIND_TOGGLE_COLLECT calls, as in the shipped summary; one round of B walk steps.

checks.assert_control: B=65544 fails with error: static assertion failed; B=65536 builds
checks.copy_mapping: i = w mod 16 enters copy (-i) mod 16, as in the eight-copy tree. Exercised, not assumed: at production B=A=2^20 with DP_BITS=8 (16,411 and 16,480 distinguished points on the two seeds, so every entry index is used) dumps, meters and digests are identical in both pairs; at production DP_BITS=60 no walk leaves the last entry.
checks.in_sequence: seed 1, rounds 1..33 and 1..64 fall by 32 and 64 times that
checks.meters: identical in every pair; dumps byte-identical in every pair
checks.mutants: index-3 leaf entering copy 1 instead of copy 9 segfaults and differs in all 65536 dump lines; a forward end test counting 8 likewise; the unmutated pair is identical at the same settings
checks.per_round: -16382 at B=2^16 and -262142 at B=2^20, the same on all three arms
checks.reach: entry branches reach 64 B against the 32768 B tbz range

unroll16.why: -(B/4) + 2, the same on all three arms: the two per-pass end tests run B/8 times each on eight copies and B/16 times each on sixteen (saving B/4 instructions), and the entry dispatch's four-bit tree substitutes one instruction for the eight-copy tree's three on the most common path, a measured +2 per round.
